expectations.text: Flags athletic / three-word writing as overused or an overdose, not a strength
expectations.evidence: Scored athletic device 2/10 on overdose; flagged 100% saturation + contrast-law failure

expectations.text: Prescribes restoring flowing sentences and reserving short lines for 1-2 emotional peaks
expectations.evidence: Top fix: de-saturate, reserve the staccato for one peak

expectations.text: Does NOT recommend adding more short / punchy / athletic sentences
expectations.evidence: No recommendation to add punch — the opposite
